Services

What the station does

From the station’s sign, its Facebook page and its Google reviews.

MOT test

The technical inspection of your vehicle at an accredited private inspection centre (CYSAB-IKTEO 1), as the sign in front of the station says.

Appointments by phone

Customers recommend booking ahead. One called the day before and was taken exactly on time, another got a visit for the next day.

Certificate on the spot

One customer writes that everything was checked and the certificate was issued, all in 25 minutes.

Waiting area

Sofas and armchairs next to the inspection hall, and a coffee or a drink while you wait, as several reviews mention.

The station

Photos from the station’s Google listing.

How customers describe a visit

Taken from what customers write in their Google reviews.

Quick

Ten reviews mention speed. One names less than 30 minutes, another 25 minutes for the whole test.

Thorough

Customers write about modern equipment and thorough car checks, so that the car is safe for real and not only on paper.

Comfortable

Five reviews mention a coffee or a drink. One notes a large parking area outside, another that pets are welcome.

An inspection station in Limassol

Zamo works at Sakkaria 2 in Limassol, in a low building with a tall sign in front: ZAMO LTD, I.K.T.E.O., M.O.T. STATION. Inside, the inspection hall and the waiting area share one bright room, divided only by a railing. 60 of its 64 Google reviews give five stars, and one reviewer especially recommends the station to expats living in Cyprus.

What customers say

Three of 64 Google reviews, all three with five stars.

“Modern equipment, thorough car checks, professional and friendly staff. If you want your car to be safe to drive not on paper, but for real this place is for you. Excellent in every way!”

Google review
“The best place for MOT in Cyprus! A cosy, friendly and welcoming place to sit and enjoy your coffee while waiting for your car! Pet friendly also!”

Google review
«Хороший сервис для прохождения MOT. Записался на кануне по телефону. Приняли строго в срок. С наружи есть большое место для парковки. Приветливый работник. Внутри зона ожидания с диванами. Чисто, уютно, угощают кофе. Сама процедура заняла 25 минут. Все проверили, выписали сертификат. (…)»
